snippet.title: Super Splash League Trailer
snippet.description:
Journey into a world where the national sport is water fighting! Form a rag-tag team and enter the Super Splash League, the biggest tournament in town.

Take turns in this low stakes tactics game, using cover, high-ground, different weapons, and various abilities to overcome the opposing team.

Meanwhile, get to know your team, their troubles and worries, and as they strive to become the best team in the League!

Will the team become league champions? or will they lose it all?

Available on Catalog: https://play.date/games/super-splash-league/
Available on Itch.io: https://mirrordoor.itch.io/super-splash-league
